printable_rule.chord_cut_note: constant-X cuts near the LE and TE cross the lip at a grazing angle (incidence 0.045 at X = 149.9150 (chord fraction 0.999)); their plane-section radius is the oblique slice of a ~0.6 mm round, not a surface radius

locked_dimensions.outline_deviation_note: below the trailing-edge face closure the silhouette is the flat trailing-edge face, which lies on the parent's trailing-edge line; the locked outline departs from that line by a h^3/2, at most 7.1e-4 mm at the closure height
